Name: Nicer Shane No More Drinking
Author: Kagurahime
Description:
After seeing some of the HORRIBLE things Shane was saying to his wife, I knew I had to fix it ASAP.

Now Shane will be civil toward you even if you are not friends and will say nicer and nicer things as your hearts increase.
Once you are married he will drink only soda and be a good hubby.

Downloads.Description: Causes Shane to be nicer to you as your hearts rise and keeps him dry after marriage.
